title: Worth it!
text:
My daughter has Shirley Temple hair; red, thick and tight curls. So we go through detangler and curl products like crazy. Recently I’ve noticed I have better results with her hair if I use a leave in conditioner opposed to detangler, but I did want a spray version of the leave in conditioner I like for her hair. That’s where this bottle comes in. I just fill it with water, squirt a little bit of the leave in conditioner into the bottle, pop the top back on, shake it up, and I’m good to go. Even though for the first few hours, the conditioner has discoed completely, I do not have any issues with clogging. The spray seems to handle the thickness without issue. Because I only need a small amount of the conditioner to mix with the water, I’m actually saving a ton of money. I used to buy detangler every other week, if not sooner. But now I have a bottle of conditioner that I can use with this spray bottle, and it’ll last me months! Thank goodness.

My favorite part of this spray bottle is that it can be sprayed two different ways. If you just pump it once, it’ll have a long mist/spray of the product. But if you pump the trigger several times, you have a continuous spray. I use regular spray bottles, so continuously pumping is something that is just a habit to do. But this spray bottle gives a continuous spray as you keep pumping, resulting in more product being released! It’s also an easy trigger so I find my hand/arm doesn’t get as tired as it usually does when doing my daughters hair.

The only reason I deducted a star was because I wish it came in a bigger size. I feel like I am refilling this often because it doesn’t hold all that much. It’s not a huge set back, but it might be bothersome to someone who needs this spray bottle in use more often. Like a hairdresser. If you need a bigger bottle, this might not be for you.

title: Sensitive Girl Approved. Not perfect but overall okay!
text:
Excellent set of brushes with pretty good quality.
#1 rule when buying Bella and bear products: get on their email list for discount codes! I paid a little more than half of the current price for this set. Even at full price it's a good value (price per brush) but due to a few quirks I recommend not paying full price.
I'm a makeup junkie and own many brushes ranging from handmade very expensive Japanese brushes to easily accessible drug-store brand sets. I prefer synthetic brushes due to allergies and skin sensitives and I believe most of these are synthetic or blends.
The set arrived from Amazon in a very nice giftable thick sturdy box. I'm actually using the box and lid as liners in one of my makeup drawers.
I have broken down this review into two sections brushes and the case.
Brushes:
Handles are semi-matte black and the ferules are silver metal and appear to be crimped on which is very nice. The handles/ferules remind me of IT Cosmetics brushes. They are very well made, heavier constructed, and feature the company and brush name stamped on them.
Brush quality is good over all. Except for one of the brushes, they are all very soft and the density is appropriate for the applications.
Foundation, stippling, large shadow, and smudge shadow brushes are not evenly cut. There is noticeable uneven brush hairs with all 4 of these. The application with these particular brushes is okay but it's not as smooth as it would be with perfectly cut brushes.
The flat yellow brush is made of a taklon or nylon type material. It's large, thick, flat, and useless. It doesn't work with any kind of makeup in any kind of application because as soon as it touches skin, it splays, or splits. It's not flexible or functional. I have put it aside for craft applications, as it might work to pat on glue or something like that.
MY favorite brushes are the white shadow blending blushes, they work very well for blending shadow lines.
Runners up are the larger powder brushes for setting powder and bronzer/blush applications.
Even with the damage to the portfolio, some brushes are not cut properly, and one is useless, this is still an excellent value.
3-3.5 stars because the handle quality is really 4 star quality and most of the brushes are 4-5 star quality but there are some misses here too.
No issues with irritations or sensitivity which is very important to me.

Portfolio:
My large heavy portfolio arrived in fair condition. The zipper, doesn't work properly, and after opening I can't easily zip it again it. This is not a big deal for me because I will not be regularly using my brushes in this case. There was a pamphlet in the bottom of the box with brush descriptions and it made a permanent indentation in the case, which would be unfortunate if I was going to use the case for storage.
The larger brushes all came with mesh brush guards, the smaller brushes were wrapped in plastic.

text:

It said something like, press the red tab. But there was no red tab anywhere. But.. I figured out an even better way to do it.
Open one package by just tearing across the top. Inside is 2 booties. You will see a red line going across... Cut that with the scissors. Make sure your feet are clean and dry before doing this.
Slip one foot into each bootie. Then what I did was I got a pair of socks, and I put them over the booties. It was a lot easier and it held the booties in place perfect.
I did one set then waited 48 hours and I used the second set. I kept the second one on for a lot longer than an hour.
After I took them off... WOW!! I could not believe how great it was working. My feet started to peel off.. It was really awesome. It was just peeling off in a very thin layer. Huge pieces. I did not get all of it off at first. So I let my feet rest for a bit, then soaked my feet in warm water, and I continued to peel the rest of my feet apart. I never knew that peeling dry skin off of my feet, could be so entertaining and fun.
I am almost done getting all the dry skin off. But I can not believe how smooth and how soft my feet are turning out.
This foot mask, really does work, and it works perfect.
I will upload a video and maybe some pictures to show you the before and after.
This Foot mask is so worth the money. IT works 100% as it says that it will work.
Simple to use. And you will be extremely happy with the results!!

title: My curls love it!
text:
I ordered the 2 oz size of this product from Amazon and just used it for the first time today. I am always wary about hair products that cost a lot of money because I go through them as frequently as I do socks...so I took a real leap of faith with this product. My hair is soft and bouncy and every curl is perfectly defined! No frizz! Normally, due to how frequently I straight iron my hair, the ends of my hair tend to not hold a curl when I try to wear it curly. So I'll have curly hair and then the ends will fall straight. Not with Quick Curls! Its almost 4 pm EST and my ends are still little ringlets! Thank god, I thought I had fried them beyond all hope.

Only one minor complaint - I did have to coat my hair in sections to get the curls to be defined, which took about 30 minutes this morning, including diffusing time. I guess thats not so bad but I'm more of a wake up and go kind of girl, which is why I usually just straighten my hair at the start of the week and then touch it up a few minutes each morning. I would love to wear my hair curly every day, if it wasn't such a process. Who knows, that's probably just because I have SO MUCH hair, not any fault of the products.

I am giving it four stars for now since I've only used it once. I will update my review once I have tried it out a few times with equal results.

title: Smells great, works better
text:
I purchased my first bottle of Castle Forbes Lime Oil Aftershave Balm in October of 2011, and I am just now replacing it with a new one. Yes, this stuff is a little pricey, but it is well worth the price to me.

This balm comes packaged in a very nice box, and inside you will find the actual bottle. It is a heavy, solid bottle, with a nice cap, and it looks very attractive sitting on your counter or in your medicine cabinet.

The first thing you will probably notice when using it is the delicious lime smell. It smells wonderful, but is not overpowering once on your skin. It is a fresh, light scent that I enjoy all year.

The balm itself is very high quality, and makes my skin feel great after even the closest straight razor or double edge shave. In the past, I used several different "sensitive skin" aftershave balms from all the big names you find in chain drug stores, and non of them work as well as the Castle Forbes. This balm works so much better that I can actually use less than the big brands, and my skin still feels more moisturized and less irritated. While a bottle of the competitors balms would last me a month, maybe two tops, the Castle Forbes has lasted me 9 months as of now, and I still have about a month's worth left in the bottle!

After using this, I have no redness, no irritation, and no razor burn. It leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized, without being greasy. If you apply too much, it can make your face feel "sticky" for a while after, but that just means you applied more than you need. With a product as high quality as this, less is more!

Overall, yes it is expensive, but you can use much less than competitor's offerings, it smells great, it feels great, and most importantly, it works!!

title: Works ok, but a wet/dry trimmer is the way to go!
text:
Had this trimmer for 2 years and it died last week after sliding into the bathroom sink under running water....

While it was working it was a good trimmer overall, though I really didn't like have to switch out the trimmer heads for the standard and then the detail sized cutters--on more than one occasion I was in a hurry and fumbling around looking for the other cutter assembly than what was on the trimmer. Another issue was that it was relatively easy to move the height adjustment by accident when taking off and replacing the plastic trimmer guard, which you need to do in order to switch cutting heads. It wasn't a really big deal, but a lot of times I wouldn't remember which number I had the hair length set on, and then I would have to guess what setting I had it one the last time I used it.....The vacuum feature was nice I guess in that it doesn't get too many little beard trimmings all over the sink, but then again it's really easy to just turn on the sink and rinse it, or, use the trimmer over a rug where you'll never see the small trimmings.....

But the big lesson here is to be sure buy a wet/dry beard trimmer that won't die if it gets a little wet. I just bought the Panasonic ER224S All-in-One Cordless Hair and Beard Trimmer [[ASIN:B000F4USF8 Panasonic ER224S All-in-One Cordless Hair and Beard Trimmer (Silver)]] which was almost half the price of the Phillips Norelco unit and it's a wet/dry trimmer that you can use in the shower. It also has a built-in detail trimmer so you don't have to switch cutter heads and worry about loosing attachments. When I went to replace the T980 that died, I avoided the latest Phillips/Norelco version because I think a wet/dry is beard trimmer is really the only way to go. So far I really like the Panasonic, and I wish I had bought one of these to start with.......

First impression, love the heart. Very surprised that so much quality went into that and then the interior was just so cheap. Stacked nozzles that don’t stay together, a base that isn’t secure, and not a snug fit: one cat outburst and this things caput! Inside is a small container but it lasted a few hours more than I expected, although with the one hole, you can’t tell that you’re even diffusing anything unless you use a whole bottle of oil. It’s just too little being dispersed which is probably why it lasts longer. I like the concept, even my kids said it was cool, but def needs better construction to stabilize and make max use of the product.

Update- I took the extenders off and just use the base and it disperses the smell much better. It also lasted about twelve hours which was surprising for such a small vessel. I’m still taking off a Star bc of the cheap base. For the heart quality, there needs to be something not only more aesthetically pleasing but safer.

Update -3 weeks later and it no longer works. We aren’t sure if it’s the base or the cord. We tried everything in our end w sev outlets and USB boxes so we know it’s not ours. Asking company to send a new cord. I really don’t want to return it but I bought it for use, not decoration..

title: No Fragrance, Moisturizing, Not The Greatest Value-Improvements Could Be Made
text:
These Doctor Babor Hyaluronic Acid Serum Power Serum Ampoules seem pretty good. I definitely like this better than their collagen concentrate ampoules, but there are things that could have been changed to make me like this product a lot more.

-Received 7 glass ampoules with 2ml of product inside each one
-Well presented in a nice looking silver display box
-You have to snap the glass ampoules open. They do provide a plastic cylindrical piece to aid in doing so. I’m a nurse, so I’m used to breaking open these kinds of ampoules without any issue. I can imagine that some people would not like this though
-Watery serum that glides across skin easily
-Honestly, a little seems to cover a large area of skin. 2ml may not seem like a lot, but a single ampoule seems like way more than would be needed for one application. I have split one into 3-4 uses to be honest
-I’m assuming the company intends for one whole ampoule to be used as one application because each one is labeled as day 1-7, and they provide no way to seal an ampoule back after using which I found to be rather frustrating
-Absorbs rapidly and doesn’t feel sticky or tacky after drying like the collagen concentrate did
-Their collagen concentrate ampoules also had a heavy fragrance, so I was SO relieved to find that there is no added fragrance with these
-Made in Germany

So does it really help with plumping, smoothing, and reducing wrinkles? I don’t know. I definitely like the way my skin looks and feels right after application, but I haven’t noticed anything drastic.
As I previously stated, the 2ml of serum feels like A LOT to me if you try to put it all on your face at once. Unfortunately, this company also does not provide a way to seal an individual ampoule back for future use since they apparently intend for one ampoule to be an entire application. I remember I tried a set by the ISDIN brand with glass ampoules just like these. In the kit, the company included a top to slide over the opened glass ampoule with a cap to seal for future use. This was awesome and so convenient. I was disappointed to find out that this company did not include anything like that (I took a picture of that top and cap on one of these ampoules so you can see).

Anyway, it is possible that this product may provide good results when used long term, but I just don’t really like this being intended for use over 7 days only. If they included a top with cap to seal each individual ampoule so that the product could be used over a longer period of time, I would like it much more. I would definitely prefer a serum in a larger bottle with dropper lid.

Anyway, I hope my review was helpful in some way, and if so, I would love to know – thanks! I’ll be sure to update if I have any other comments to add.

text:
Y’all- I am OBSESSED. My hair is thin and simply doesn’t grow and in my 32 years of existence- I have never had hair extensions. Like WHAT have I been doing with my life?! But again- it is absolutely worth it. I instantly felt like a better version of my self. Glamorous. Confident.
As I’m writing this- my extensions are right at the three week mark and have started to slip and fall out. I immediately knew I had to buy more. So I thought I would stop and write this review because I know, if you are like me, you are obsessively reading reviews on a product like this before you take the leap. DO IT! Trust me, you won’t regret this purchase.

title: An expensive mixed bag
text:
There are only a few reviews on Castle Forbes' Special Reserve Neroli. A couple are on here, a few randomly online. You have to dig for them. So if you're reading this, you're more of a fragrance lover than the average Tommy Bahama fan. Put simply, CF Neroli is not a popular EDP, nor is the brand. You have to know some things about fragrance and have a specific knowledge about neroli itself, to have come searching for Castle Forbes version. This is how I came to know this brand and EDP myself.
My view is that it's not worth the cost of 160USD. That's a lot of money for a 3.4oz. bottle. CF has a nice brand image, the EDP presentation is great, and the quality of the materials used are outstanding. However, the scent alone falls short.
Neroli Reserve starts out wonderfully: crisp orange and neroli, combined with greens like pine, grass and hedges. You feel like you're at the beach, sitting just where the sand dunes meet a lush forest. This lasts for about 20 minutes. Then the "woody/musky" basenotes kick in, and this is where CF got it wrong. It deteriorates into a powdery, barbershop, very British scent. It's something your grandmother (not grandfather) would have worn if she lived in London in 1865. Designer houses today try and replicate this a bit, usually just producing a floraly, loud, baby powder vibe (see MDCI Invasion Barbare). This basenote scent is what then dominates for the next 10 hours, more if you've sprayed any arm/chest hair. The woods aren't masculine woods, just faint tree bark really.
The EDP strength is phenomenal; this stuff lasts. The only problem is whether or not you like to smell like a woman, particularly a powderpuff with flowers. I do get some faint whiffs of neroli, but it's overpowered by the floral powder. I would not recommend this for a man, and unfortunately, would recommend Tom Ford's Neroli Portofino over this. A different vibe for sure (more aquatic), but TF's neroli sustains.
Overall, 3 of 5 stars just because the ingredients are so good, but the scent isn't as much neroli as it is the musky amber that CF used. Bummer.

I had on a very dark red polish which was wearing very intensely for a week. Removal with some removers would leave red stains everywhere.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This polish remover comes in the same type of bottle most store brands do. There is no special scent and it is typical remover.

HOW DID THIS PERFORM?
This polish remover took off the red polish with no problem, left no red staining, and did not leave my nails completely parched like some harsher ones might.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This polish removes regular nail polish (not talking about gel here) very well. It does not leave nails too stripped.

MY RATING
Five stars. It does what it is supposed to to without excessive problems or smells.

title: This flat iron is MAGIC!!
text:
As you can see, my “before” hair is very badly damaged: drugstore dye every 3 weeks, regular exposure to the AZ sun/heat & pool chlorine, plus I haven’t gotten a haircut in nearly 2 years so my split ends have split ends. Yet this little flat iron somehow makes my abused, frizzed-out hair look smooth, shiny, and healthy! It also feels very soft, with nice movement & body. The photos have not been edited aside from brightening up my bad bathroom lighting, and I did not use any oils, sprays, or other product in my hair after the usual shampoo & conditioner. It took me approximately 6 minutes to style, not including time for the iron to heat up (it’s pretty fast, I just didn’t time it).

I dare say it might even work better than the $129 “professional” flat iron I got at a beauty supply store, though my old iron has been with me for 12 years so it definitely has some wear & tear. Still, it’s pretty impressive considering the very reasonable price for this one! The only minor drawback is the awkward control buttons, which are inside the handle & close to the hot plates, though I have not burned myself using them (yet). They’re also a little confusing and I have no idea what the strip of “infrared” lighting inside one plate is supposed to accomplish. So, I sought out the enclosed instructions and found this paragraph (verbatim):

“Amino-bond is produced with the photosynthesis of ambipolar light of 68000Hz(wave length 680nm) and the elemental amino acid made up of the horny layer of hair so that the hair fiber and its elasticity will be restored, the hair squama gap will be densified again and the cellularity and squama gap will be restored.”

Sooo...yeah. No idea what any of that means! But I really can’t argue with results. You definitely will not find a better flat iron at this price point. I’d give it 10 stars if I could!

text:
So I don’t own a blow dryer or a hair straightener. I know. I bought this to hopefully replace the need for both of them. Pictured: my hair styled when damp, my hair styled and natural side-by-side, and my hair styled when dry (tie-dye shirt).

Some pros: I have very wavy, long, fine hair, but a ton of it, and can dry/style my hair in under 30 minutes with this. Yes the brush size is huge, but with how much hair I have, I need it to be large. The style it produced was beautiful! I will be keeping this for sure!

Some cons: I deducted a star mainly because this brush doesn’t get very hot. I guess this could be a pro since it won’t damage your hair as much over time. But for me, I noticed that some parts of my hair were still wavy, and that the style didn’t hold perfectly over time.

Some tips: definitely use this tool on damp hair. It semi-straightened my dry hair, but the style did not hold over time and my hair went right back to wavy in an hour. I had to go over my damp hair a few times, but make sure to maintain tension when you pull. That’s the best way I was able to get my hair straight. Another reason I deducted a star was because I still feel like I need a flat iron to do touch ups—around my roots specifically. But this product is definitely better than using a flat iron all over!

Verdict: worth $20! Glad I purchased.

Easy to turn on and off, simply press a button.

Cons:

title: This is an excellent product. It can be very very messy though
text: This is an excellent product. It can be very very messy though, so make sure when you do get it you get it in the tube with the needle nose applicator, and not the brush on type. I use this product in making seamless tape in hair extensions.  I apply it to the hair Wefting tape before I stick the hair weft to it, and then I put another line of it on of the other side and sandwich the hair in between the two strips of tape. Then just apply heat to the tape/glue using your flat iron. It only takes a few seconds. The heat activates this Glue to make an extremely strong seamless tape in extension that does not come apart. This product is absolutely ideal for that. You can use it to create taped in hair extensions that last for multiple installs. I have tried to use this product a few times to just Glue weft extensions directly to hair, but this does not work so well even though I believe that is specifically what this product is sold for. They usually slip and release after the first shampoo when you use that way; but for making seamless weft hair extensions for tape in application, there is not a better product out there. Feel free to contact me if you'd like to know how to make your own hair extensions.

title: Must have! It really really really really works!
text:
I've had mine for several years now and I could not be more pleased. I'm not going to go into details about all the things everyone else has already said, but I do have a fantastic tip to share.

Lay down on the bed while brushing! Brushing at the sink for 2 or 3 minutes seems like an eternity (especially if you are one of those people who often gets the toothpaste drooling down your chin). Laying down while brushing is one of the best ideas I have ever had. Try this for at least a week and you will be hooked! Relax. Let the toothbrush do the work while you lay down and relax. Enjoy the feeling of the toothbrush massaging your gums and cleaning your teeth. Take your time, and RELAX! (I know, I keep saying relax over and over, but seriously, try taking a little meditation and relaxation break). This makes a mundane chore actually quite enjoyable. If you do this, you will find that you brush longer, and you AND your dentist will notice the results. WARNING! Wait until you get back to the sink to brush your tongue so you don't gag or choke.

By the way, I also have a Sonicare and use it on a regular basis but I prefer this one because it's more controllable.

title: Adorable, well-made, compact and portable device for face cleaning/massaging. Pricey though.
text:
This is a silicone face pusator/massager. One side features soft silicone bristles that are useful for working any topical application into your face. The other side features a few ribs and can be used for simple face massage (no creams/topicals).

You turn it on by pressing the power button on the back (massage side). You turn it off the same way. There's a travel lock you enable by pressing the + and - buttons simultaneously for three seconds. You disable the lock the same way.

The device integrates a 300 mAh LithiumIon battery. That's not huge, but it's big enough to give a rated 300 minutes of run time. So it's enough to throw into your travel bag or purse (after a full charge) and not worry about running out of juice.

It fits reasonably well in the hand. The vibration intensity can be adjusted in 8 levels using the + and - buttons. Personally, if I'm gonna use this, I'll be using the highest level, and at that level it dusts up a good amount of lather (if the topical you're using can lather). If you have sensitive skin, the lowest level is quite low--just a low hum of buzzing.

Honestly, this is a sweet face cleaner. There is a caveat here, though. And that is that this device is quite pricey for what it is (silicone with a moderate-sized battery and a small buzzing/vibrating unit inside). So whether it's worth the price will be a matter of personal preference. It's perhaps closing with a note that this comes with a two year warranty, unlike cheap similar devices, which usually with a blink and you'll miss it warranty.

Pros:
** Cute and stylish
** 300 minutes run time on a full charge
** At highest level, capable of a getting a topical (or soap) lathering well
** Lowest level is low enough to satisfy those with sensitive skin
** Travel lock-out mode
** Two year warranty

Cons:
** Expensive

title: Excellent Hair Care
text:
Disclosure: I was contacted by Luseta and offered this product. I accepted, promising a fair and honest review in return.

This is a clone of the review I wrote for the Luseta Argan oil shampoo/conditioner set. I have nothing else to add about this product; all things I said in that review apply here.

I love this product, and will look to buy it again, even online. I think it smells great, and it has done a fantastic job of cleaning and conditioning my hair.

I like the packaging, a simple deep crimson/violet color, classy and not overstated. No screaming text, just a simple logo and simple listings of what you get inside.

The color is a simple white cream. No outrageous greens or pinks or blues; colored shampoo only seems to make sense if you've got colored hair. The scent is fantastic, understated and clean-smelling, not overly flowery or soapy or thick with artificial perfumes.

The shampoo pumps out of the bottle easily and under control, just the right consistency to pump well but not to shoot all over the place. Same with the conditioner. Both go on easily, mix easily, and rinse just as easily and completely.

The two bottles are not gigantic, but I am only now running out of this product after approximately eight weeks of daily use. A set will easily suit two people for a month or more. That makes it most definitely cost-effective for the current sale price of approximately $26.

Bottom line: this is an excellent product that I will purchase again.

title: Warped from Containing Polish Remover
text: After containing Mineral Fusion nail polish remover (one of the most popular, most effective removers on the market), this bottle stopped dispensing as well as it had. Upon inspection, we realized the acetone had started warping the all the parts so that the lid wouldn't totally close anymore, too much acetone started coming out per pump, and, most dangerously of all, the bottle itself had begun warping and starring. What's happening is it is liquifying the plastic and causing it to become molten, but on a very slow level, with the plastic molecules moving because of the organic chemistry of the acetone interacting with this particular type of plastic. It was only a matter of time before it bottomed out in my bathroom cabinet all over everything. Basically, this should be made of the same type of plastic as bottles that hold acetone and for long periods of time, at that. Furthermore, the straw should be of a sturdier material.

I'm very impressed wit this hair care kit. I've never done so many products in one go but it was worth it.

First I used #0 on my dry hair. After 10 minutes I added #3 and let it set for 10 minutes. I know I can get another use out of that bottle.

Then I hopped in the shower and rinsed my hair and it felt very smooth as I rinsed it. Then I shampooed with #4, rinsed and then conditioned with #5 (left on 3 minutes). Once I towel dried my hair and I applied the mask #8. After 10 minutes I rinsed the mask out of my hair.

I really didn't notice the scents of #0 and #3 but #4, #5, and #8 have nice, light scents. I can tell my hair is in better shape after these treatments. I can get two full uses out of the kit in the future with additional uses out of #4, #5, and #8.

On one hand, I was putting off going through all these steps but now I see that it's worth the time it takes.

title: You get what you paid for!
text:
The cost is cheaper than most other replacements as they are not Official Norelco Brand. So, remember why they are cheaper. My experiences with these HQ8 replacement heads/blades:
The center caps popped off the heads as they came out of the package, I successfully super glued them back on. I tried this replacement HQ8 set on an older XL and then moved them to a brand new Turbo Norelco. And on both shavers, they randomly pinch or pull your facial hair really hard. I kept my old blades from the XL and obviously the new shaver has good blades and heads. The issue with the replacement set here is the dual precision heads. THE FIX: I took the original Norelco brand Lift and Cut heads and put the new HQ8 rotary blades inside the old lift and cut heads and it works great. You can see a difference in the design of the heads. The picture on the right are my old lift and cut heads with the new HQ8 blades installed inside them from this HQ8 package. The head design on the left has an issue with pulling hair and pinching. I would recommend this modification if you experience that nasty pinching and ripping facial hair out with this HQ8 replacement set from Amazon.

title: 192 lash clusters, 12mm-18mm
text:
The Bodermincer lash clusters, mix 12mm-18mm with 4 rows of each size were not my favorite. First off, the case that they arrived in was quite large, almost the size of a small tablet with 2 latches that are supposed to lock so the case doesn’t come open but neither works. The adhesive strip that the clusters are attached to, I had one of the clusters rip apart when trying to remove it from the adhesive strip with eyelash tweezers (grabbed by band like always). The lash clusters are also very top heavy as you can see from my side shot above picture where the lash drifted out of place after being glued (you need to supply your own glue, not included). I held each cluster in place with lash tweezers until glue was set because I was having trouble keeping them where I wanted them. The lash clusters themselves are more of a U shape and very thick at the band with a slight flair going up/out. They do have a slightly variegated length to them but it’s not super noticeable and the curl on them was more of a C than a D. Clusters are soft but the band holding them together is sharp and slightly uncomfortable when wearing (I always glue lash clusters underneath eyelid, I think it blends better).

When removing the lashes at the end of the day most of the clusters either fell apart of several individual lashes came off the bands. I would not recommend this particular set of lash clusters.

title: Great product and great results
text:
Searching for a safe and effective skin brightener is always my top priority because I have a never ending battle with skin discoloration and dark sunspots. I love the fact that this serum is gentle and does not contain the harsh chemicals that most skin lighteners do because I prefer using products that have natural and botanical ingredients as much as possible. This product comes in a dark amber dropper bottle which protects the product from sunlight exposure. It also contains Glycolic and Kojic Acids as the key ingredients which I believe will lead to clear and brighter looking skin. This serum keeps my skin smooth, shining and flake-free. It is not greasy and does not form a film. I have somewhat sensitive skin which is pone to irritation and redness, but this serum is very gentle without causing any breakouts or negative side effects. I believe it has been gradually improving my dull looking appearance by making the spots a bit lighter.

I use the product as directed after cleansing, toning my face and allowing some time to dry before topping with my regular moisturizer. This light weight clear serum not only applies smoothly and evenly, but it also has a fresh light scent that will dissipate after it dries. It has a liquid gel like texture which leaves my skin soft and smooth, not to mention it is also fast absorbing without any uncomfortable feeling and leaves my face quite moisturized. I have even started using it to lighten the sun spots on my hands and the results are impressive. Although I have not been using it for long, my skin tone has started to look more even and I have also noticed that some of my blemishes have cleared up along the way. My darker spots still exist, but they look much better and I can see some significant improvements of my lighter ones.

I am sure everyone's skin is different, but I have experienced zero sensitivity or dryness. I love how much clearer my skin looks throughout the day and my skin feels more balanced. My overall appearance is much brighter and smoother. The brown spots on my hands are slowly fading in under two weeks and I can say that I am really happy about it. In fact, everybody's skin type is different and the effects may not be the same or visible for everyone. I have used it twice a day for quite some time now and the brightening effect seems to be progressing. There is no miraculous or overnight whitening as such, but with gradual fading of sun spots, my face does appear clearer and even toned. This product does what it promises and lightens my dark spots. This is a great and reasonably priced dark spot corrector serum that I will definitely buy again and I feel quite confident to explore other products from the same line to further improve my skin conditions.

Disclosure: I purchased this dark spot corrector at a discount for my honest and unbiased review.

title: Easy to apply
text:
One of my favorite beauty YouTubers wears false lashes and I have always been so envious of how much they make her eyes pop. I have tried regular strip lashes before that you glue in and I can never seem to get them on or if I do it takes several attempts.

I saw the YouTuber try out some magnetic ones so I thought I would give them a shot. I didn't want to invest a ton of money in case they were a total flop.

I decided on these and glad I did. The case the come in is really cute and I like how there is a mirror inside.

At first I thought there were no instructions so I was like "what the heck". However once I pulled up the plastic insert to remove the magnetic eyeliner, I saw them underneath.

I do recommend doing your eye makeup as normal and if you wear black eyeliner, put that on first and then put a small amount of the magnetic liner on top of that. Let it dry and out them on. BAM! Lashes were easy to apply and I didn't feel like they would fall off. I do think they might be a little too wide for my eye because I could feel them quite a bit in my inner corner. I might try trimming them, but not sure yet.

title: Atomic Pink is fantastic
text:
After reading many reviews on Atomic Pink, I went with this color for the first time ever dying my hair pink. I found some tips online that I followed before I dyed it and I'll relay some of them here.

One thing that is pretty common knowledge is that the more damaged or processed your hair is, the EASIER the color will take to your hair.

So knowing that, I bleached my hair (Using Manic Panic's amplified bleach kit) to get my hair as light as color (It made my hair near-white but it would probably still give a decent color even at the light orange stage) and after rinsing the bleach out, I avoided conditioning my hair as I usually do after a bleach job.

Tips I was given:
1- Make your hair damp. it helps the dye to cover evenly and considering the last time I tried dying my hair a funky color it ended up splotchy despite being in a similar bleached state, I think it definitely helped.

2- Mix the dye with conditioner in a small tub (I personally rinsed the little tupperware that came with the bleach kit since it has a lid and I could cover any I didn't use). Conditioner was said to make the color last longer and it also helps to repair your hair since you've likely just bleached the hell out of it.

3- If mixing with conditioner (It didn't dillute the color at all for me but if you use a signifigant amount it just might), start with just a couple of teaspoons of dye at a time to make sure you don't waste any. I ended up making two "batches" and still had some leftover, and barely used any of the bottle, but my hair is very short.

4- Cover your hair with a plastic bag (or shower cap) when waiting for the dye to take. It'll keep your hair from drying out and also keeps the mess off your neck and clothes

5- A tip I was given but didn't try was to blast your hair with hot air with a hair dryer right before you wash it out. Highly suggested if you use a red or blue.

When washing out your hair the first time, don't use shampoo. Even the second time you wash your hair, don't use shampoo. Only use shampoo when your hair looks dirty. Invest in some dry shampoo to use between washings. Less washing means a longer lasting color! That said, I dyed my hair on Valentine's Day and I've washed it three times since then and the color is still as vibrant as when I first dyed it.

REMEMBER just because color is washing out of your hair doesn't mean your hair still has dye in it. Your hair is likely to bleed for awhile. Don't use your best towels or pillow cases or wear light colored shirts for awhile.

If your color does start to fade, just mix up some more dye and conditioner to refresh it. You can also mix a tiny bit of dye into your conditioner and shake it up and use that regularly.

text:
I wasn't sure if these would sublimate as no other reviews had mentioned anything other then HTV and the exact type of material is not listed. I decided to give it a try and they turned out very nice!

My method: Please note I am not an expert of any type-this is just what worked for me and my equipment-your heat press may be different-plan to have a few extras to allow you to develop a method for your own equipment. It took me 2 (using both sides) to get a design and method I was happy with.

Prepress for 10 seconds at 375 degrees. Be sure to ALWAYS have blow out paper under and over PLUS a sheet between the sides of the ribbon. If you do not put the sheet between the ribbon it will meld together at the edges. Do not reuse blow out paper as you will end up with ghosting on your next sash-LOL I know from experience!

I found it easiest to lay the sash out flat and tape it to the workspace after prepressing. I made sure to tape in the middle of each end so I'd have a guide to center my words. After taping design with heat tape-tape well DO NOT skimp as you may have to press 2 times due to the length of the sash and your design so tape good so it can move without ghosting images.

Then I pressed each section for 35 seconds at medium pressure and 375 degrees. I allowed to cool flat and then rolled the sashes to prevent creases from returning.

I am very pleased with them for the price. The material is a true white. the sewn end has one edge sewn to allow it to open and lay flat on the hip. While not the thickest material it is adequate for a sash. Packaging was exceptional! Each sash was packaged in it's own clear plastic sealed pouch THEN all those were packaged in a vacuumed sealed heavy pouch. There was no odors. Length was normal however as a plus size person (size 24) I could get it on but it rode up oddly on me and did not lay flattering. A suggestion for manufacturers is to make some longer plus size sashes as I'd surely buy them to offer my clients a range of inclusive sizes. I will order again without hesitation.

title: Almost perfect
text:
I purchased an sleep mask just like this in a store and, when it went missing, searched for it high and low until I found it here on Amazon. The mask blocks light well with little or no light leaking in around your nose and none around the eyes. The contoured eye coverings place no pressure on your eyelids. I never felt comfortable sleeping in a traditional sleep mask until I used this style. I can even open my eyes in my mask and my lashes don't even brush it.

The comfort in wearing meant I quickly adjusted to its use and now can't hardly sleep without it. As someone who has had trouble sleeping and finds napping almost impossible, having the routine of perfect dark when I sleep at night has allowed me to build a trigger. Now, when I need to sleep early, want to catch a nap, find myself in a plane, or other times I might ordinarily find it hard to sleep, I can place my mask on and it signals sleep perfectly. It's improved my sleep length and frequency, as well as reduced the time it takes me to fall asleep, which I think anyone could appreciate.

My only gripe is that, while I thought this one was exactly like my previous mask, there's a little difference. There's a little plastic piece on the side of the elastic that joins loops for the adjustment system and they sit very near my ears. I can sometimes feel it digging in and I never remember feeling that on my previous mask. For occasional use, you may not notice it, but using them nightly, the little part can bother me sometimes. My solution plan involves breaking the part and replacing it with something soft or hand-sewing that connection point. Customization is a very small price to pay for the amazingly comfortable contoured foam that makes up the main body of the mask.

This non-acetone polish remover from Plant Therapy smells so good! To me, it smells a lot like fruit punch (Hawaiian Punch, to be exact). I did not have any issues during shipment, so I think this bottle will be fabulous for travel. This acetone-free formula removes traditional crème & shimmer polishes with little effort. The solvent base contains Ethyl Acetate & Isopropyl Mistrate. I wouldn't use this as my first defense against removing glitter lacquers, and I wouldn't use it to soak off gel polish at all. This is basically a rebadged pumice scrub that you can buy at the drugstore - check the ingredients, it's right there - pumice. There are no specific ingredients to help with KP, just some essential oils that you'd find in most scrubs.

Just like the cream, this product is for sale anywhere besides Amazon - you can see that because they've printed the Amazon barcode itself right on the label. There's no real UPC. This product can't even be sold in stores because of it's labeling. Just another marketing company relabeling a basic scrub for KP. Don't fall for the new products like this one that pop up periodically - go with something that's been around for a long time.

title: my new favorite
text:
I have very blonde lashes, so mascara is something I wear daily, and because my natural lash color is so light, it's really easy for me to tell when my mascara has worn off. This mascara has good staying power, and it gives me the feathery, long, full lash look that I love. I worked as a Clinique Business Manager for many years, and in addition to all the free make-up Clinique gave us, I was also able to try many different high-end mascaras I normally wouldn't have purchased, such as Lancome, Chanel, & Dior. My favorite back then was Clinique's Long Pretty Lashes which has since been discontinued, and ever since then, I've been on the hunt for my perfect mascara...one that stays on without flaking or clumping, no raccoon eyes, one that has buildable coverage and can also be reapplied without getting gunky. I do not like mascaras that give you twiggy lashes, and because I like my lashes defined and separated, feathery soft and full, I prefer a natural bristle brush over silicone brushes.

So as you can tell, I'm very particular about mascara! My favorite before trying this one was Neutrogena's Healthy Volume mascara and Guerlain's Cils D'enfer was a close second, although too pricey IMO. I love this Mamey mascara even more! I had read an interview of Salma Hayek's about Mamey Seed oil which is what led me to this mascara. Although my natural lashes are fairly long, they are also thin and getting sparse with age, so if this stuff helps to regrow them, that will be wonderful! In the meantime though, just using this makes my lashes look amazing! title: Super Thick formula, but it's great stuff!
text:
Okay so let me first say I didn't buy mine from Amazon. I bought mine through eSalon's Match-Up program (3 products per shipment for $30, the first month is $15) I ordered the Big Love Shampoo, Big Softie Conditioner and, Get Lifted Root Lift Spray. I have her fine thin hair so I am always on the lookout for products to boost volume without breaking the bank. I have tried all sorts of products, everything from Living Proof, to Nioxin, Aveda's Invati line, Redkin, Purology, etc. Now, I'm not saying the products from the other lines don't work, a lot of them are great, but they cal also be pretty pricey. I already use eSalon to color my hair (if you haven't tried them yet, you should) and their regular shampoo/conditioner packets they send along with your hair color are great (and smell amazing). But I need VOLUME, not southern beauty queen volume, but volume none the less. So! In comes Big Love & Big Softie. For $15 for my first order I couldn't say no. Both the shampoo and conditioner are SUPER thick. So thick I had a little trouble getting them to pump out of the bottles. I was worried that something so thick would just weigh my hair down and it would have been a waste of money. I WAS WRONG. The big test for me is "second day hair". Most volumizimg products do well the day you wash, and that's great. But, what about the next morning? The answer, NOPE. I'm on my second day hair as I wrote this and it still has some decent volume to it. I can't swear it's just the conditioner, but the shampoo/conditioner/root lifter combo worked really well. I would recommend it. Especially if you do eSalon's Match-Up. Three salon quality products, of your choice for $30 is nothing to stick your nose up at. Ill be ordering it again for sure, next time with their Volumizing mousse (just to give it a try too).

TL/DR: Give it a try, it's a very thick formula, but it works and it won't break the bank.

title: Wonderful for moderate or less curly hair
text:
This is a good straightener. I have very curly hair. Getting that hair tamed is quite an undertaking. I loved the idea of having a brush and straightener in one. The hard plastic exterior is very durable.

My hair resembles a puff ball in it's natural state without any products in it. So, straightening my viciously curly hair is quite an undertaking. This straightener did get my hair straight. Although, it was a puffy straight. After I applied a product, The puffiness went away. A normal flat straightener is able to achieve a non puffy straight without the need for products.

I will say that this worked perfectly for my daughter who has moderately curly hair. This brush hair straightener gave her a flat straight look with only one or two swipes. By these findings, I would say this is ideal for people with moderate or less curly hair.

Using this straightener is extremely simple. The LED light up screen makes the screen easy to see the temperature and other controls. The buttons easily press on the handle. This straightener also headed up to the full temperature in 1 or 2 minutes. After I unplugged it, it took around 5 minutes for it to completely cool down.

The quality of this straightener is exceptional. The hard plastic material is extremely durable and does stand up against my vigorous daily use. The brush itself is very strong. Even while attempting to get it through my puff ball of hair, the brush did not bend or break. The cord is also a long cord that is very thick. All of the connections between each of the pieces is quite substantial. I did not feel any movement between any of them.

Overall, I would recommend this hair straightener if you have moderate or less curly hair. The quality of the construction and design is exceptional. I rate this 5/5 stars. I did receive this at a discounted or free rate for my honest and unbiased opinion, but all opinions expressed are my own.

title: A Very Nice Hydrating, Soothing, Barrier-Repairing Antioxidant Serum
text:
(Ingredients list is at the bottom of this review.)

I have really enjoyed using the Celleanser Vegan Clean Serum, and my skin seems to like it too. I also tried the Celleanser Clean Toner Mist, and the Celleanser Clean Cream. They all worked nicely for my dry, sensitive skin, and they worked nicely together.

This serum is creamy with a viscous gel-like texture that provides an extra layer of hydration, moisture, and antioxidants on the skin. It is applied before moisturizer. The serum is smooth and cooling when applied. It soaks in well, but it does leave a nice layer of extra hydration on the skin. It is not sticky, and it layers perfectly with other products. The scent is sort of lightly herbal or earthy, similar to many Korean skincare brands.

I will say that the finish isn't my go-to. It isn't really dewy or glowy. But I wouldn't call it extremely matte either. Maybe somewhere in-between, but more toward the matte side. I typically like to use dewy, glowy skincare, so I would probably use this product at night for that reason.

The packaging is very nice with a unique-looking, tall, slim plastic bottle with a very functional pump. A little goes a long way, and I imagine this bottle will last me a while. At $19.99 for 30ml / 1.01 fl. oz., it's a pretty good deal. Especially because the ingredient list is nice.

I haven't been using it long enough to speak on the long-term results, but I do like the serum so far, and I will definitely continue to use it. I would recommend this to anyone who likes the ingredient list and wants to give it a try.

title: What a piece of garbage!
text:
I was highly skeptical about this gadget, but when I ruptured a disk in my back, I decided to take a chance. I should have listened to my instincts.

Let me put it bluntly. This contraption does not work in ANY way as advertised. Anyone saying otherwise HAS to be a lying SHILL!

The suction cups don't stick to the floor of tub or stone shower. At all. This makes every other feature kinda worthless. The point of this toy is to not have to bend over to scrub the dirt or smooth out the calluses on your feet. But since it won't stay put, there is nothing easy about cleaning your feet with this thing.

Since the suction cups didn't stick to the floor, I tried jamming the thing in a corner and holding it there with my other foot. But even if you can get it to stay still enough to rub your foot on the brush, the bristles are weak and cheap. They flattened out with the third attempted use. The stone is small and even more useless than the brush.

This is the perfect example of a sucker product! Wouldn't it be great if this worked? But it doesn't. SAVE YOUR MONEY!

A long handled bath brush/pumice stone combo actually does work. If you use it while seated, there is very little bending involved, saving your back.

title: Pretty nice quality hair for the price.
text:
I've been using extensions since 2006, due to health issues causing extreme hair thinning. I used to get the fused extensions at the salon, 1500 dollars back in the day. They broke off from the weight of the extensions because my hair was so fine and thin. The fused glob of hair was just too much and so many fell out. I started buying the clip in hair, taking the clips off and using them as weft hair. I use salon pro white glue, much like eyelash glue but used for weft hair. It is a wonderful solution and I still alternate between tape in hair and the clip in wefts. I also buy closures and custom color, to make my own toppers. What a job! But, I'm happy with the results. I have more control over the color and style, and I feel 'normal'.

This hair is a medium to coarse texture, thick, and has a really nice body wave. The is soft and smooth and doesn't feel damaged. It will blend with fine hair. You can use a straightening iron, just be sure that you can control the temperature. Once you burn this hair, it will stink and it will be ruined. However, if you control the temperature and use care, the hair looks great straight and shiny. You can also curl the hair. I have used felted hot rollers, and those work really well. They are safer, and not as damaging, and the curls last so long.

These 16" extensions are very nice. Although the ad isn't quite accurate. The color is a darker caramel blond, and a reddish brown. This is not piano keys, but close. The wefts are not in the ombre style, they are bold and varied high lights. If you look at the ad images, the photos showing the people aren't shown with this product in their hair. The wefts laying on a surface showing the color differences between the offered colors is the most accurate. I've offered some images that show the color more accurately. You can custom color most of the wefted hair, but adding color is easier. Typically the hair has so much red in it that it is impossible to cover or remove, and the dye can be hard to remove. You can add a longer root to eliminate the chunky roots. My hair is so fine, the sewn edge can be obvious, so have a good match to my natural blonde ash tone roots helps. Any coloring will add to the damage and potentially shorten the life of the hair, but for me it makes me happier to have an exact match to what I want, and I am hard to match for color.

The weight of the hair is shown in a photo in ounces. In grams, we get a little over 104 grams, far less than the advertised 120grams, and I would complain about this and have, just not for this brand. That being said, the fullness and the weight is still good, and the wefts seem to feel average when compared to what I usually order. If you order the longer options, the hair will be thinner, as most hair is sold by weight. 120 would be better, of course. This weight is significantly lower than 120grams.

Shedding. Over the last 7 years or so, shedding has become a real problem. It never used to be this bad. There is a weft glue that is meant to slow or prevent shedding and I always use it. It makes the weft more stiff, but if you use the weft the way I use them, you need to do something to protect your weft hair. You can find it online. If you are using this hair for special occasions and clipping to thick strong hair and are simply making your hair more full, wild and glamorous, then you may not need to worry about shedding. I did finger comb this hair once out of the packaging, and there was significant shedding. Again, I say, this is a common issue now, and unique to this particular brand. I have no idea what changed but the wefts should not shed this much, but they all do this with most brands. I have to say that if the wefts didn't shed so much, they would last for a couple of years or longer. Also, keep in mind I use the wefts differently, so clipping, as intended, may offer longer life and far less shedding.

The length is 16" and the hair hangs nicely, with a gentle, natural taper. There is a very nice body wave. It's not a blunt edge finish, which is nice.

The clips are the same type that I see on most clip in kits. They are small, and hold nicely even on fine hair.

Over all, I think this is a great value and will require the extra effort to keep them looking great over a year or more. To keep human hair looking good and tangle free, I use the sleep and shine shampoo and conditioner. It keeps the hair fresher and mat free longer. There are a lot of youtube videos that can help you with application and care, and give you tips and tricks.

4 stars.

title: Effective Lotion for Intense Skin Needs
text:
There is much to appreciate about this Zeroid Intensive Lotion for Severe Dry & Disordered Skin. This is a Korean-made product and I do tend to be a fan of most Korean skin care products.

This arrives in a 6.76 ounce bottle. It was nicely sealed. I was modestly concerned about the product's clearly labeled manufacturing date 3/11/2020 indicating I'm receiving it over 16 months after the manufacturing date. While this isn't always an issue, it doesn't particularly instill confidence.

This lotion uses what the manufacturer calls MLE Technology along with Defensamide and Ceramides along with Squalane for moisturizing. It is noted as being good for all ages including babies and children.

While I had some concerns, I'm overall pleased with the product's performance. This is a white, smooth lotion that applies easily. I'd actually just had some seasonal allergy reactions on my skin while working in the yard and opted to use this on my skin. It soothed my skin greatly and has gone to work surprisingly rapidly to calm down my inflamed, swollen skin. I'm actually quite impressed.

There's no scent that I can detect.

In terms of value, this is fairly modest. While this is being advertised as somewhat of a premium lotion, I'm not sure I can justify continued use - we'll see how it continues to do and if I notice a definite improvement over other products. However, I definitely can't deny that it's effective and it is definitely making my skin look and feel better.

Zeroid is noted as the #1 Dermacosmetic in Korea for the last decade. It's easy to understand why as this product works incredibly well and surprisingly quickly.

Overall, while I am a bit concerned about the manufacturing date and the price point is a touch high I'll continue to use and compare it to other available products. For now, I'll say I'm impressed and happy with the lotion's performance on my troubled skin.

title: TARTE IS THE VERY BEST
text:
I have used "Tarte Shape Tape Hydrating Foundation" since it first came out and have loved it. Tarte has done away with the 'Shape Tape Foundation' and has replaced it with..... "Face Tape Foundation."

I tried the "Face Tape Foundation" which is somehow a blend of the 'matte' and the 'hydrating' Shape Tape Foundation formulas. It didn't do well for me. It did not seem to cover as well, and it didn't give my skin that airbrushed glow and look. It was ok, but wasn't superior to other foundations on the market like the Shape Tape Hydrating Foundation was.

I am a Baby Boomer and have dry skin that has lines and some wrinkles. The Hydrating Foundation really made my complexion look very good. It has become more and more difficult to find my shade in the Hydrating Formula which is 29B. Now that I can no longer find it, I decided to try the Shape Tape Matte Formula in shade 29B.

I see from other reviews that the Matte Formula can be very drying, settling into pores, wrinkles and lines. When I wore it, it felt like it literally sucked the moisture right out if my facial skin, leaving it almost painfully dry!!!

I have discovered a way to sidestep that and make this look and feel just as nice as the Hydrating Formula. Under my moisturizer, I apply a thin layer of Argan Oil. Then after a couple of minutes I apply my moisturizer. Then I apply "Tarte Base Tape PRIMER." This primer is amazing and seriously the best I've ever used. It is amazing how it makes the Matte Formula look and feel as nice as the Hydrating Formula. It leaves your skin feeling so supple and moist, but not oily.

I'm thrilled I can still find the Tarte Shape Tape Foundation in my shade, even in the Matte Formula. With the benefit of argan oil and the superior Tarte Base Tape Primer, the problem has been resolved.

I will buy a few more bottles of the Shape Tape Foundation, Matte Formula while I can. It's the absolute BEST foundation I've ever used.
Thank you Tarte!! (Tarte also makes the very best concealer ever made...."Tarte Shape Tape Concealer", still available and in production).

title: weightless, non tacky, fully absorbs quickly, NO added fragrance, no scent
text:
I have Rosacea, specifically type 1 where I experience redness from flushing and visible veins (telangiectasias). Otherwise clear skin. While topicals won't really help the veins, I can use products that help even out skin tone where it is pink from flushing. Some products can initially make my skin red, then it calms down (especially if new). This ISNTREE Cica Relief Ampoule Duo Set has not irritated my skin. In fact, it has helped to minimize aggravated skin.

The serum is extremely light. I think the lightest weight product I have ever used. The bottles are small, and I feel like I am going through it quickly. I may be using too much, I dont know. I do apply to neck and chest as well as face. I already use a product with EGF (epidermal growth factor), and I thought that maybe in serum form it would feel like a more concentrated dose. I have no idea how much Isntree uses, but this product feels like the emphasis is on the Centella Asiatica Extract. That isn't necessarily a bad thing, I am just not sure yet what I think about the performance of this product for my skin. The two small bottles would be better as 1 bottle.

--super light weight
--absorbs instantly
--not tacky
--skin feels instantly smooth (I also use some on the back of my hands)
--I wouldn't use it alone as a moisturizer, especially if have dry skin (like me)
--gentle, doesn't aggravate my skin, but that very well could differ for everyone (esp those w/ damaged skin barrier)
--contains soothing centella asiatica extract
--contains EGF- worth doing some research to see the benefits and to discount myths.
--ingredients that can help build and maintain skin barrier. Especially important for those with skin conditions where they are exacerbated by a damaged skin barrier. Got super sensitive skin? work on repairing that skin barrier before anything else.
--NO added fragrance in ingredient list. No naturally occurring scent either. I cant detect any aroma.

My skin: mid 40s, smooth and clear (except for visible veins), leans dry. I follow this up with a moisturizing SPF (their sunscreens are great) or a moisturizer if using at night.

I dont think it is bad. I really just think it is ok. I would give it 3.5 stars if I could. For me it isn't quite a 4 star product, so I am going with the middle of the road rating of 3. Your experience will vary. I think it would be especially appealing to those who prefer a weightless non tacky Centella Asiatica product. While I have zero issues with this, I am not likely to repurchase it. I have preferred products, especially for EGFs. However, if I notice anything else-- good or bad, I will be sure to update. It can take at least 2 weeks for a product to show its effectiveness, and it can take that long for the skin to acclimate to a new product. I am a little early on writing this, but my skin is used to centella asiatica as well as EGFs, and with some Isntree products.

title: Not my favorite lash serum
text:
This is the second brand of eyelash growth serum I've tried, and decided to try this brand because it was considerably cheaper. This is another example of "you get what you pay for".
In the past I have used Rapidlash. I was amazed at how long and full my lashes were after only a few weeks. I'd say it took about 3 weeks for it to really show, and the results were amazing. Over time I got a little lazy and took my new full, long lashes for granted and stopped using Rapidlash. Gradually my lashes returned to their normal short, thin condition.
I knew I needed to start using lash growth serum again and decided to try Uptown Eyelash Growth Serum. It was cheaper, and advertised longer, thicker lashes in just two weeks.
It's been about 3 weeks ... and, yes, my lashes are somewhat thicker and longer. If I hadn't tried Rapidlash in the past, I would think lash serum a waste of money. Not really enough difference to justify the price or inconvenience. What this experience did show me is that there are great lash serums out there, this just doesn't appear to be one of them.

title: I'm happy with this toothbrush...
text:
I wanted to shop around for an electric toothbrush because, despite my best efforts to brush at least twice a day and floss, I still felt like my teeth weren't getting clean enough. My battle involves bleeding gums, which requires that much more cleaning power in between your teeth in order to get rid of the bacteria that's keeping them inflammed. The Vitality brush does a pretty decent job of reaching deep into the surfaces and the spaces of your teeth to get them clean. Licking my teeth, they feel pretty smooth, too.

The toothbrush is recharged with an adapter unit. Remove it from the base, put on your toothpaste, and turn the unit on. The agitation has a little bit of splashback to it, so minimize it by brushing the back of your teeth first and then moving to the front; then the outside surfaces, then the inside. Also, the brush head is fairly small compared to standard brushes. I thought it was a little distracting at first until I started brushing to pay more attention to individual teeth rather than sweeping broadly across them. Finally, I thought the timer was a digital read-out; your brush will vibrate a couple of short pulses to let you know that two minutes is up. It was disorienting at first. I thought the brush was out of power, but I figured it out.

It's a solid investment, and the good thing is that it's relatively affordable and still an effective device compared to more expensive powerbrushes on the market.

title: World's Best Electric Shaver
text:
My wife bought me this Philips Norelco 1059X shaver last Christmas after complaining about my so called self cleaning Remington R1000 shaver. I can tell you that I always had issues getting the R1000 to shave under my nose well. I also had to still clean out the shaving head even with the fluid running through the R1000. The cheap China made pump motor died on the R1000 and Remington sent me a new shaver which turned into another piece of junk. When I first used this Norelco 1059X it got those missing hairs under my nose and after 5 months of using this, it still shaves very close as it flexes to the contour of your face very well. It's very comfortable to hold and handle while shaving. Cleaning this is one of the best things about it. You just flip up the 3 hinged shaving heads and rinse under the faucet. It's extremely clean and ready for the next use. Even an indicator shows up above the digital battery life indicator to remind you to wash it out which by the way only takes 10 seconds if that. I've used Norelco since I was old enough to shave as my Dad handed me his used one when I was 14. That was 40 years ago. Why I bought that Remington is beyond me.

Now here's the best story I can tell you about this shaver. I took a trip to the Philippines back in March. Out of habit, I packed the power cord and shaver as I always did with the old one. I left without the charging stand (my unit came with two types). Yep I was dumb for doing that I thought but the stored energy on this thing allowed me to shave every day I was there without a charge the entire 22 days I was gone. And it still had a charge for another day or two after I returned from that trip. I'm telling you this has to be the world's best Electric Shaver and it was purchased right here at Amazon.

text:
I have never taken the time to actually review a product but I just had to for this one. Let me tell you a little bit about my skin condition and how this product has affected me.

I'm 26 years old with very fair skin. However, many of my high school/college years were spent in a tanning bed. I've always loved my skin when tan but when it finally sunk in that if I kept tanning I would look like a prune, I luckily stopped for good. However, I always hated the way my skin looked. Very blotchy, often dry, and I still get pimples at 26! I've tried every product under the sun and nothing, at least for me has lived up to its promises!

This product is truly amazing. When I first tried it, it stung my sensitive skin. I used it for about 2 weeks then stopped because I didn't think it was working. If you have acne prone skin, it will make you break out a little at first because all of those pimples will be forced to the surface. So I stopped using it. However, after reading all the good reviews, I decided to give it another shot. It's been about a month of using this product and boy have I seen drastic changes in my skin. My skin is 100 percent softer and smoother. Old acne scars that I had (my skin scars very easily) are lightening up and my complexion is much more even. And, the best part is, I get no more pimples so don't have to use drying products like benzoyl peroxide anymore!! My face is so smoothe throughout the day and it stays that way! It is truly amazing, but the trick is, you HAVE to give it about a month before you will truly see results! Be patient!!

Ok, for those with a similar skin condition to me, just want to let you know my skin care routine using this product.

Morning - wash with cetaphil daily cleanser, apply alpha hydroxy souffle, let dry then apply good moisturizer ( i use eucerine spf30) Make sure you use a noncomedogenic one with a good sunscreen!!

Evening - wash with plexion cleansing clothes (need prescription), apply alpha hydroxy souffle, then a good night cream ( i use neutrogena visibly even night cream and it's worked wonders)

I also take nicomide which is a vitamin my dermatologist prescribed for helping with acne.

Sorry this review is so long, but I just really wanted to offer my advice and let you know what has given me amazing results! If it wasn't for websites like this, I would never have known to purchase all of the products I use! I really hope this helps!!

title: Better than expected, given all the sponsored reviews
text:
Note: this is not one of those I-got-this-for-free-and-am-writing-a-glowing-review reviews. I am really sick of those, by the way.

I self-tan after nearly every shower. I live in California and have to look the part, you know? But after two years with Fake Bake, I decided it was time to try to find something a little more low maintenance (Fake Bake is great, but the mitt is 100% necessary and the extra accessory to deal with is frustrating).

I went on Amazon, quickly scanned reviews, and ordered this. Then, while waiting for its arrival, I read the reviews and was frustrated to find that nearly all were written by sponsored users, and are therefore untrustworthy (I don't care if you say the review is "honest", I just cannot give the benefit of the doubt to a trend more associated with scams than hot tips). Nevertheless, I decided to give it a shot.

This WAY exceeded my low expectations. It blends really easily (almost no streaks!), smells relatively good, isn't sticky at all, DOESN'T RUB OFF MUCH ON SHEETS / CLOTHING (a little is to be expected from all skin dyes, but some are noticeably awful *cough*fakebake*cough*), and gives a pretty realistic tan, assuming you're not ghost white to start. Totally worth the adventure away from Fake Bake in my book.

HOWEVER, if you use your hands to apply this, you better have a stack of sandpaper nearby because this will instantly dye your palms brown. I haven't tried using plastic gloves, but I am a little disappointed that a mitt is once more necessary. At least in dire circumstances my hands are a possibility, unlike Fake Bake.

Will probably buy again

title: NOT YOUR "OLD DUTCH" NORELCO
text:
I've used Norelcos for over 30 years. This latest version comes from China, with questionable implications as to quality and conditions of manufacture.
Extremely light and quiet, it feels more like a woman's shaver. Therefore, it may not be suitable for men with heavy beards who are not accustomed to electric razors.
Older Norelcos were solid, well made and came with solid cases; this model has no case at all, making careful handling essential. Considering this shaver's apparent fragility, if you ever drop it you'll need a new one. Norelco switches have always been erratic, so leave the switch turned on and unplug the shaver to turn it off.
For the moment it does a good enough job, even without a closeness control. Its best feature is a full-sized trimmer, which works well.
If today's lower quality standards for small appliances don't bother you, you may find this shaver perfectly acceptable but it is not built to last as long as its predecessors.
UPDATE (11/07) - Well, this fragile shaver is still going strong - of course, I've managed not to drop it! No complaints, and the price has gone down a third since I bought it. Definitely the best shaver one can get at this price.
UPDATE (1/13) - Unfortunately I left the original shaver behind at an hotel and sorely missed it until I found a new, unused one on the internet. Norelco has apparently discontinued this model along with all their corded-only shavers, so if you can find one as I did, you're lucky!

title: Perfect for a good warm lather and no clanking the brush on the rim!
text:
I've been using (or rather, trying to) Col Conk's shave soap pucks and their shaving soap mug. I was not getting the performance I'd heard of that makes shaving with a DE razor and warm shave soap so enjoyable. I decided to change both the mug and my soap. I've had this bowl for a few weeks now-it holds heat well and with my super badger brush and Proraso shaving cream (in a squeeze tube, not the pre-filled bowl of Proraso) I get a very fast, think 20 seconds or so, thick and warm lather built up. I've found I get best results when I add the hottest water I can get from the tap to the bowl add the brush to soak and then hop in the shower to let the brush and bowl warm up. I then dump the water out and refill it with hot water, let it sit for a minute or so then pour it out. (The initial fill of the hot water loses a bunch of heat just warming the porcelain, the second fill of hot water is the heat you'll use to make a nice warm lather. The bowl retains the heat while you apply the shave soap.). Don't forget to refill with hot tap water and let the heat build back up before you pour all but about a tablespoon of water out then add an almond sized dollop of the shave cream from the tube. The raised swirl on the bottom I'm of the bowl seems to work well and help build the lather.

One more thing-the bowl is wide enough that I no longer need to worry about clanking the brush against the rim and waking my wife up.mthat was a problem with my Col Conk mug-too narrow at the top. This bowl works very well for me, I'm quite pleased with the purchase!

Solid CNC machining for super durability, perfect blade alignment, and hold. The standard blade base was very easy to use. The next day I switched to the aggressive base, the one marked with an "A". This base is for more experienced shavers, and I was very pleased with results. The "A" base opens up the razors head, giving you more access to the blade. This also gives you a larger margin for error, but it lets this nice heavy razor do it's job' and do it well. The razor glided through my thick stubble under it's own weight, with hardly any extra pressure. A quick pass under running water, and well placed rinse holes on the bottom of the head, jets water across the blade. This pushes out all the hairs (even my thick stubble), and leaves the blade clean and ready for the next pass. This razor shaves great.
In the end. I gave the RazoRock MJ-90 five stars, for it's durability, quality materials, and the adjustable head that gives a great shave, no matter what your skill level. I could not fault this razor for anything, and it is my new daily driver.

I haven't seen this much English information about Yokosuka in one place...not even on web blogs or review sites. I have lived in Yokosuka for nearly three years, and there is a lot in this guide that I previously wasn't aware of because of the cultural nuances and language barriers that challenge us "gaijin".

A lot of my friends in Yokosuka have this book, and their relatively new copies are dog-eared because they are really USING the guide to explore the areas in and around Yokosuka. This book is very family-oriented, since there is a lot of focus on restaurants and fun stuff that doesn't include the local bar scene...which is a nuance rather hard to find online. However if you're new to town and looking for a watering hole, there are tons of restaurants, izakayas, and karaoke places listed in this guide which have a much better drink selection and atmosphere than most bars in the Honch.

I hope that future editions of this book will include photos, but I'm incredibly pleased with this guide, and only wish that I had more time here to explore it ALL!!
